data.one_liner: Canvas library extending CustomPaint with event handling and frame control
data.what_it_does: RePaint provides a widget and painter that let you draw on a canvas, handle mouse and keyboard events, and control repainting. It adds features like inline widgets, frame rate control, and a quad‑tree for hit testing.
use_when: Need interactive drawing or custom UI elements
Building a simple game or sketch app
Adding custom hit‑testing or event handling to a canvas
Want to control frame rate or repaint boundary
avoid_when: Simple static UI that can use standard widgets
Projects that already use a full game engine like Flame
strengths: Frame rate and repaint boundary control
weaknesses: No built‑in physics or game loop
